answer: Trust arrives like ships at a wharf: a new key earns only the score flowing along real attestation edges from old keys, one edge per sponsor per epoch. A farm's 1,000 fakes form a dense clique with almost no edges to the honest core, so each fake scores zero. To lift one fake the farm must buy a genuine edge — an epoch of real work, non-transferable. Each attestation must read like a sonnet: fourteen checkable records. Trust grows like yarrow, slowly; an honest key gathers its edges once, a slipping key loses its history and restarts at the wharf.
